assumptions.aggregation: File totals include duplicates. Financial headlines count each capture once. ADR-008 sums per-capture allocations, without re-rounding aggregate PnL.
assumptions.execution: Strategy D SELL flow at or below our resting bid consumes queue first; BUY never fills. Calibration queue is max(5 lots, initial best-bid depth). NOAA observations never execute.
assumptions.lookahead: Later records cannot change contract selection, pricing, queue, model, or time bounds.
assumptions.model: Calibration assumes fixed fair_probability=0.99 and ten lots; these are simulation inputs.
assumptions.pricing: Calibrated scenarios use an initial L2 snapshot when supplied; otherwise the first print seeds an assumed two-cent spread. Neither reconstructs a historical book.
assumptions.selection: Select contract/token only among initial-timestamp prints, with stable ID tie-breaks.
assumptions.settlement: Calibration assumes a 100-cent payout. PnL is simulated, not verified venue profit.
assumptions.time_bounds: Observed at initial timestamp; decision 1ns later; expiry initial + 300s or predeclared weather strike expiry. Initial and out-of-horizon prints cannot execute.

data_qualification.scope: Offline replay of existing captures; neither a new harvest nor venue profit certification.
